Sixteen identical full-depth slots take transmitters, receivers, amplifiers and a power supply from the front; the rear of each slot takes the module's dynamic back plate, which carries its optical and RF connections, or a half-depth passive. A mid-plane between the two carries the 12 VDC bus and the RS-485 management bus.","format":1,"gaps":[{"note":"a front blank is named once: the FA3500 data sheet's ordering note ships \"a BP3000 blank face plate\" with the FA3524S, for the front of the slot its double-wide back plate leaves empty. No document draws or photographs a BP3000, and no rear blank is named in any of the 164 data sheets held; a rear plate legended BP3001 appears beside a BP-P2 in the CX3003C sheet's photograph and is probably the rear blank, but no document names or describes it.","reason":"needs-photo","scope":["front","rear"],"wanted":"a photograph or drawing of the BP3000 front blank, and the part number of the rear blank","what":"slot-blanks"},{"note":"the PS3006D and PS3006N on the HT3580H chassis photograph carry an older face - a 3.5 mm jack legended Serial in place of the micro-USB, and vertical vent slots on the PS3006N - than the PS3006 data sheet's own photographs. The current face is modelled.","reason":"needs-photo","scope":["front"],"wanted":"the revision history of the PS3006 faceplate","what":"older-psu-face"},{"note":"the HT3580H data sheet names three back plates for a CA3008 carrier and photographs one, the BD31A8-100-H10F modelled here. The BD31A8-100-H18F (eight BC inputs, no NC) and the BD35M8 mux plates (-ACx and -EEx with three SC/APC, -DCx with six LC/APC, each with nine F-type inputs) are described in text only, so their layouts are not drawn.","reason":"needs-photo","scope":["rear"],"wanted":"a face-on photograph or drawing of a BD31A8-100-H18F and of a BD35M8","what":"quad-density-mux-back-plates"},{"note":"the FA3524S ships with a double-wide BP-F3 back plate (three SC/APC ports for its input and two outputs) that leaves the neighbouring slot empty for cooling, per the FA3500 data sheet's ordering note 2. The BP-F2, BP-F2-AL and BP-F4 are drawn in that sheet; the BP-F3 is not, so an FA3524S can be seated but its back plate is not modelled.","reason":"needs-drawing","scope":["rear"],"wanted":"a drawing or photograph of the BP-F3","what":"fa3524s-back-plate"},{"note":"the chassis data sheets state the arrangement - \"32 half-depth slots (16 front-loaded and 16 rear-loaded)\" and \"32 midplane electrical interconnects (16 front and 16 rear)\", and the OR3144H sheet says a half-depth module can be plugged in from either side - so a half-depth module seats in a slot's front bay or in its rear bay, where a full-depth module's back plate would go, and that is how the half-depth modules modelled here seat. No photograph held shows one installed, front or rear, to confirm its face against the slot, and most of the half-depth passives - and the DT3550N transmitter, whose data sheet has no face image - are not modelled yet.","reason":"needs-photo","scope":["front","rear"],"wanted":"a photograph of a CH3000 with half-depth modules seated, front and rear","what":"half-depth-slots"}],"groups":{"back-plates":{"description":"the rear of each slot, where a module's dynamic back plate or a half-depth passive seats","index-origin":1,"role":"traffic","term":"Slot"},"inlet-plates":{"description":"the BP-P1 back plate behind each power supply, carrying its AC inlet. The supplies' redundancy is stated once, on the psus group; these plates are the supplies' inlets and not a second set of supplies.","index-origin":1,"role":"service","term":"Slot"},"psus":{"attrs":{"redundancy":"1+1","redundancy-note":"PS3006 data sheet, Features - \"Supports redundant power supplies\", and the PS3006N's B/U PS lamp is \"Lit if second power supply is present within chassis\". The sheet names redundancy as the only reason for a second supply and never a combined rating, so two are read as the same capacity twice; the form is not stated."},"description":"the power supply and chassis controller, two full-depth slots wide. PS3006 data sheet: \"Supports redundant power supplies\" and \"Occupies two full-depth slots\"; any two adjacent slots may take one, and these bays sit where the photographed chassis has them.","index-origin":1,"role":"service","term":"Slot"},"slots":{"description":"the full-depth module slots, identical and taking any active module from the front","index-origin":1,"role":"traffic","term":"Slot"}},"kind":"device","manufacturer":"CommScope","maturity":"modelled","model":"CH3000","name":"ch3000","profile":"optical","provenance":{"back-plates":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"every active module mates a dynamic back plate seated in the rear of its slot(s); the chassis data sheet says the dynamic back plates let a module be replaced from the front without touching the cabling at the back. So the rear view's bays hold back plates, one per module, spanning the same columns."},"chassis-variants":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"sold as CH3000C (top and bottom covers, 7 kg) and CH3000N (no covers, 4.5 kg). The views model the CH3000C's covered box, which is what the HT3580H photograph shows; the N's open frame, photographed on the Aurora 2004 sheet, is not drawn yet."},"depth":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"CH3000 Chassis data sheet, Dimensions: 13.3 in D (34 cm)"},"height":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"CH3000 Chassis data sheet, Dimensions: 5.22 in H (13.5 cm), 3RU"},"slot-height":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"module faceplates run y 142-497 of the 1344 px chassis photograph, 355 px = 130.2 mm of the 132.6 mm face, leaving the frame rail visible above; drawn centred at y 1.2."},"slot-numbering":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"FRONT 1-16 LEFT TO RIGHT; REAR 16-1 LEFT TO RIGHT as seen from behind, so front N and rear N are one mid-plane column. The chassis data sheet says only \"All slots are identical (no specific slot allocation)\", but the controller's display numbers them: on the HT3580H photograph the PS3006D in the two left-hand slots reads \"Slot 2\", and on the Aurora 2004 sheet's front photograph a PS3001D counted into slots 10-11 reads \"Slot 11\". So the vendor counts from the left, and A TWO-SLOT MODULE IS ADDRESSED BY ITS RIGHT-HAND SLOT - a two-slot bay is named for both slots (slot-1-2) and takes the higher number as its rel-pos."},"slot-opening":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"AN EMPTY SLOT IS OPEN FROM ITS NEIGHBOUR'S EDGE TO ITS OWN, so each bay's opening is the full 26.76 pitch (53.52 for a two-slot bay) while its size is the faceplate's 25.76. The 1.0 mm between faceplates is clearance between modules, not metal: the Aurora 2004 sheet's empty-chassis photograph shows one open span between the top and bottom rails with no divider between slots, and both faces are declared open-frame."},"slot-pitch":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"26.76 mm. Each slot carries one captive thumbscrew on its centre line at the top of the module face; on the HT3580H chassis photograph the sixteen screws fit a straight line of 72.97 px pitch with a largest residual of 1.65 px (0.6 mm). The Aurora empty chassis gives 26.75 from its rail holes against the 433 body. A faceplate is one pitch less a 1.0 mm gap (25.76; a two-slot module 52.52), the gap read between the PS3006D and the first CA3008 on the same photograph."},"sources":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"datasheets and photographs only - the CH3000 Chassis datasheet (2022) and its Aurora 2004 predecessor, the Chassis Accessories datasheet, the PS3006 and AR3002E datasheets, and the HT3580H datasheet whose p1 photograph is the face-on chassis front every front measurement is taken from (all in `references`). NO INSTALLATION MANUAL OR HARDWARE GUIDE IS PUBLIC: the vendor's sit behind an entitled support portal, so nothing here comes from one, and slot placement rests on photographs."},"width":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"433 mm between the side walls, from two photographs that agree. The HT3580H sheet's p1 chassis front, stitched from seven 1344 x 73 tiles, spans 1316 px between the rack ears' outer edges - the data sheet's 19.0 in (482.6 mm), which INCLUDES the ears - giving 2.727 px/mm, and the face's 360 px height against the data sheet's 5.22 in agrees to 0.4%, so the face is near-orthographic. Its sixteen slots span 428.2 mm. The Aurora 2004 sheet's empty CH3000N front puts the slot pitch at 6.178% of the outer frame; 26.76 / 0.06178 = 433.1.
